_note: Phase 2 draft. Resource type = the nature of the artefact. It is independent of standardisation status (see `maturity`) and of what knowledge it represents (see knowledge-domains.json).

families.label: Ontologies & semantic models
families.summary: Machine-readable models of meaning: ontologies, vocabularies, schemas and modelling languages. The catalogue opens on this family.

families.label: Engineering & AI technology
families.summary: Standards documents, datasets, frameworks, simulators and AI frameworks.

items.label: Ontology
items.summary: Formal model of concepts and relations with defined semantics (e.g. OWL, Common Logic).

items.label: Vocabulary / taxonomy
items.summary: Controlled terms, thesauri, classification systems or lightweight RDF vocabularies.

items.label: Data schema / information model
items.summary: Structured information model or meta-model for exchanging data (e.g. EXPRESS, UML/MOF, AAS meta-model).

items.label: Modelling language
items.summary: Language with defined syntax and semantics for building engineering models.

items.label: Standard / specification
items.summary: Normative document without a machine-readable model of its own (e.g. a safety or test standard).

items.label: Dataset
items.summary: Published collection of data with stated provenance and licence.

items.label: Framework / reference architecture
items.summary: Reference architecture or software framework, for example for digital twins.

items.label: Simulation resource
items.summary: Simulator, physics engine or reusable simulation model.

items.label: AI framework
items.summary: Framework, toolkit or model family for AI, including robotics and embodied AI.
